scope: Read-only schema review of current local report scaffold. No rendered final dataset existed when checked; this is not final visual QA.
findingFieldsSupported: approved screenshot or explicit no-reference statement

gaps.issue: Figure caption chooses caption or notes instead of the role/width/state context. A supplied note can hide the required capture context.
gaps.recommendation: Always display route, role, viewport and state together, then append notes/caption. Keep timestamp and full-image option.
gaps.verification: Check one capture with notes and one with caption in the final rendered report.

gaps.issue: Session Export saves only status and note; it is not the complete supporting finding register.
gaps.recommendation: Save a separate full finding JSON or CSV alongside the report and link it from the report. Retain the explicit session-only review export notice.
gaps.verification: Ensure the full register includes every consolidated finding and all mandatory fields.

gaps.issue: An approvedReference narrative containing an evidence ID does not display that image.
gaps.recommendation: Set approvedReferenceScreenshot to the actual approved reference capture where available, and keep approvedReference as the authority/context statement. Do not label a merely existing implementation as approved.
gaps.verification: Check comparisons at matching scale and viewport, and ensure every absent reference says so explicitly.

gaps.issue: Behavioural findings need explicit reproduction steps; prose alone is easy to miss.
gaps.recommendation: Populate reproSteps or reproduction for each observed behavioural finding, including the safe stop/cancel boundary. Reviewer B findings now all include reproSteps.
gaps.verification: Every claimed observed interaction is traceable to a lead-recorded action and current capture.

gaps.issue: Multi-area findings supplied as one joined string become a composite Area filter option.
gaps.recommendation: Supply area as an array for findings with independently affected areas, and ensure visible tags render each value clearly.
gaps.verification: Filter Media, Transcripts, Script and Storyboard independently and confirm shared findings appear as intended.

gaps.issue: The renderer fallback allows a scaffold with no populated report data; no data/report-data.js was available at this review checkpoint.
gaps.location: index.html and report.js initial data handling
gaps.recommendation: Populate consolidated data, then render-check navigation, evidence links, filters, enlarge and review export/import. Do not present the scaffold as the finished review pack.
gaps.verification: Data totals reconcile with master coverage and full finding register; no broken image/source links.

positiveChecks: Mandatory finding field renderers are present.
Coverage, baseline, comparisons, pages, decisions, batches and limitations have navigable sections.
Review choices are described as temporary; explicit JSON export/import exists.
Selecting Approved in the local review session is explicitly not authority to implement.
limitations: No final dataset or rendered final report was validated in this source schema pass.
No screenshot image approval is inferred from an evidence ID.
Parent lead remains responsible for consolidated decisions, duplicates and final handoff.
